description: Implement stable-distinct-by. It takes a key function and a finite collection and returns a vector containing the first item for each distinct key, preserving input order. nil and false are valid keys. nil or empty input returns []. Accept lists and finite lazy sequences; handle repeated structured keys. Call the key function exactly once per item. Do not mutate input or add dependencies. Avoid quadratic scanning: acceptance includes 200000 items with 10000 distinct keys.

Implement dependency-order. nodes is a vector of distinct Clojure values, including possibly nil, false, maps or vectors. edges is a vector of [before after] pairs. Return a vector containing all nodes exactly once with every before preceding its after. At each step choose the earliest node in the ORIGINAL nodes vector among ALL currently ready nodes, including newly ready nodes. For example nodes [:a :b :c :d] and edges [[:c :a]] returns [:b :c :a :d]. Duplicate edges count once. For an endpoint not present in nodes throw ex-info with :type :unknown-node. For any cycle, including a self-cycle or a disconnected cycle, throw ex-info with :type :cycle. Empty input returns []. Do not mutate inputs or add dependencies. Acceptance includes a 10000-node chain; avoid quadratic scans.

Implement project-events. initial must be a Clojure map, otherwise throw ex-info with :type :invalid-state. Reduce a finite collection of event VECTORS into the final map: [:put key value] associates any value; [:delete key] removes it, missing key is a no-op; [:increment key delta] adds integer delta to an existing integer value, treating an ABSENT key as zero. A present nil or false is not absent and cannot be incremented. Keys may be nil, false or structured. Event operations and arities must match exactly. Reject non-vectors, unknown operations, wrong arities, noninteger deltas, and incrementing noninteger existing values using ex-info with {:type :invalid-event :index i :event event}, where i is the zero-based index of the first invalid event. nil events means no events. Support finite lazy event sequences. Do not mutate initial/events or add dependencies. Acceptance includes 100000 increment events.
